results.source_text:
@[simp]
theorem mk_eq_zero {g : R[X]} : mk f g = 0 ↔ f ∣ g :=
  mk_eq_mk.trans <| by rw [sub_zero]

results.name: AdjoinRoot
results.source_text:
/-- Adjoin a root of a polynomial `f` to a commutative ring `R`. We define the new ring
as the quotient of `R[X]` by the principal ideal generated by `f`. -/
def AdjoinRoot [CommRing R] (f : R[X]) : Type _ :=
  Polynomial R ⧸ (span {f} : Ideal R[X])
results.docstring:
Adjoin a root of a polynomial `f` to a commutative ring `R`. We define the new ring
as the quotient of `R[X]` by the principal ideal generated by `f`.

@[simp]
theorem mk_eq_mk {g h : R[X]} : mk f g = mk f h ↔ f ∣ g - h :=
  Ideal.Quotient.eq.trans Ideal.mem_span_singleton

theorem isRoot_root (f : R[X]) : IsRoot (f.map (of f)) (root f) := by
  rw [IsRoot, eval_map, eval₂_root]

results.source_text:
/-- `disjUnion s t h` is the set such that `a ∈ disjUnion s t h` iff `a ∈ s` or `a ∈ t`.
It is the same as `s ∪ t`, but it does not require decidable equality on the type. The hypothesis
ensures that the sets are disjoint. -/
@[simps]
def disjUnion (s t : Finset α) (h : Disjoint s t) : Finset α :=
  ⟨s.1 + t.1, Multiset.nodup_add.2 ⟨s.2, t.2, disjoint_val.2 h⟩⟩

@[to_additive]
theorem prod_union [DecidableEq ι] (h : Disjoint s₁ s₂) :
    ∏ x ∈ s₁ ∪ s₂, f x = (∏ x ∈ s₁, f x) * ∏ x ∈ s₂, f x := by

results.name: Finset.disjoint_union_left
results.source_text:
@[simp]
theorem disjoint_union_left : Disjoint (s ∪ t) u ↔ Disjoint s u ∧ Disjoint t u := by
  simp only [disjoint_left, mem_union, or_imp, forall_and]

results.name: Finset.noncommSum_union_of_disjoint
results.source_text:
@[to_additive /-- The non-commutative version of `Finset.sum_union` -/]
theorem noncommProd_union_of_disjoint [DecidableEq α] {s t : Finset α} (h : Disjoint s t)
    (f : α → β) (comm : Set.Pairwise ↑(s ∪ t) (Commute on f)) :
    noncommProd (s ∪ t) f comm =
      noncommProd s f (comm.mono <| coe_subset.2 subset_union_left) *
        noncommProd t f (comm.mono <| coe_subset.2 subset_union_right) := by

results.name: FieldStatistic.ofFinset_union_disjoint
results.source_text:
lemma ofFinset_union_disjoint (q : 𝓕 → FieldStatistic) (φs : List 𝓕) (a b : Finset (Fin φs.length))
    (h : Disjoint a b) :
    ofFinset q φs.get a * ofFinset q φs.get b = ofFinset q φs.get (a ∪ b) := by
  rw [ofFinset_union, Finset.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mp h]
  simp

results.name: Equiv.sumEquivSigmalCond
results.source_text:
/-- An alternative form of `Equiv.sumEquivSigmaBool` where `Bool.casesOn` is replaced by `cond`. -/
def sumEquivSigmalCond : Fin m ⊕ Fin n ≃ Σ b, cond b (Fin m) (Fin n) :=
  calc Fin m ⊕ Fin n
    _ ≃ Fin n ⊕ Fin m := sumComm ..
    _ ≃ Σ b, bif b then (Fin m) else (Fin n) := sumEquivSigmaBool ..
    _ ≃ Σ b, cond b (Fin m) (Fin n) := sigmaCongrRight (fun | true | false => Equiv.refl _)
results.docstring: An alternative form of `Equiv.sumEquivSigmaBool` where `Bool.casesOn` is replaced by `cond`.
